READING_20260824.WHAT_THIS_IS: the five-member extension authorized by Joseph on 2026-08-24 ('Yes extend it to the other members'), job 57519250, COMPLETED 01:40:22, all five rc=0. replica_29 was measured separately in 57517628 and lives in RECEIPT-20260824-oi126-c-permutation-ensemble.json; the six-member statements below combine the two and say so each time.
CITABLE_FOR: the composition model as a quantitative prediction: it holds for all SIX members, worst 1.39 standard errors against a bar of 3.00 declared before the run
both THRESHOLD-INDETERMINATE cells (replica_45 4.40x, replica_26 3.74x) being explained as composition, at leverage 3.37 and 2.43 where the test genuinely could have said otherwise
the row sets A/B/C1 being IDENTICAL positions across all six members (one shared idx2_sha256), so the six R5 cells were never independent probes
the genuine row-set sampling sd per member, and the ratio of the 2.4e-3 bar to it
the controls: every member's fast path reproduces its own published dL values to <= 3.3e-10 relative
NOT_CITABLE_FOR: anything about OI-126. Row-set sampling at FIXED weights is neither estimator-equivalence nor coverage; both remain untested.
'six confirmations' of the R2 read. Only 2 of 6 tests had genuine power (leverage >= 2.0). The other 4 are 'consistent with, cannot exclude' -- see THE_POWER_SPLIT_IS_THE_HONEST_PART.
'dL is stable on validation rows'. The validation draw/pool fraction is 0.9994 for every member, so that sd is one set measured 200 times, not a spread.
adoption, pairing or promotion of any PET product.

THE_POWER_SPLIT_IS_THE_HONEST_PART.WHY_THIS_MATTERS: the two powered members are exactly the two whose R5 cells read THRESHOLD-INDETERMINATE, i.e. the two this run existed to settle, and both came out consistent with composition. That is a real result. The other four are UNDERPOWERED reads and must not be counted as four more confirmations -- a low-leverage 'consistent with the draw' is a failure to exclude, not a positive finding.
THE_POWER_SPLIT_IS_THE_HONEST_PART.WHAT_CARRIES_THE_SIX_MEMBER_CLAIM_INSTEA: R4, the composition model, which is a QUANTITATIVE prediction with a predeclared bar rather than a null test. It holds 6/6 at 0.01 to 1.39 sem against a bar of 3.00, and the direction of the effect differs between members, so it is not one effect re-tested six times.

THE_ANOMALY_WAS_MANUFACTURED_BY_USING_PO.READ: no draw was anomalous. Mean |z| is about 1.2 and the max is 1.82 -- exactly as unrepresentative as single draws should be. So the defect was never that a draw was strange; it was building a PREDICTION from point estimates and then reading the prediction's miss as a fact about the mechanism. replica_29's '6.9% below the composition prediction', which consumed a discriminator job, needed only a +1.40 sd endpoint -- an ordinary draw occurring about one time in six.

AND_AN_ORDINARY_DRAW_CAN_FLIP_THE_APPARE.detail: replica_00 at +0.97 sd and replica_43 at +0.78 sd -- one-sigma draws, the most ordinary object in statistics -- each show B ABOVE A while their train POOL mean is BELOW their validation pool mean. Neither raised an alarm, because both cells read IMMATERIAL. Anyone reasoning from the DIRECTION of those cells would have been misled.

THE_BAR_AGAINST_GENUINE_ROWSET_NOISE.exceed_frac_over_0p05_in: 5 of 5 here, and 6 of 6 including replica_29
THE_BAR_AGAINST_GENUINE_ROWSET_NOISE.READ: on a genuinely re-drawn mixture subset the 2.4e-3 CONFIRM bar is at or BELOW the row-set sampling sd for every member -- ratio 0.49 to 1.13. That is a stronger form of the concern raised before the first run and it holds across the board. It does NOT reach dL(A), whose row set is 0.9994 of its pool and therefore near-deterministic. Both halves are needed: the sweep's primary numbers are reproducible, and any comparison ACROSS row sets at this bar is inside the noise.

THE_ROW_SETS_ARE_SHARED_SO_THE_SIX_CELLS.READ: i2 depends only on n2 and the global numpy RNG state at the shuffle, and the per-member bootstrap_seed does not advance it. So A, B and C1 are the SAME POSITIONS for all six members. Agreement among the six R5 row-set cells therefore counts once, not six times. These 200-draw ensembles are the first thing in this campaign that varies the row set independently per member.

THE_PROSE_DEFECT_IS_MINE.what: the CLOSED branch of my R2 string hardcodes 'replica_29' and the word 'both'. Emitted unchanged in the artifacts for replica_45 and replica_26, where the member is not replica_29 and there is exactly ONE named draw.

The branch I rewrote is clean; the branch I copied forward is not. Parameterising a single-subject instrument for many subjects means the STRINGS are part of what must be parameterised, and only the code I touched got audited.
THE_PROSE_DEFECT_IS_MINE.why_it_was_not_patched_mid_run: the job stamps ONE producer md5 for all five members. Patching after replica_45 and replica_26 had run would have made that stamp false for the remaining three -- trading a provenance corruption for a labelling fix.
THE_PROSE_DEFECT_IS_MINE.the_computed_verdicts_are_unaffected: all(i95) ran over each member's own named list, and the percentiles, leverage and pool statistics are that member's. The prose is wrong; the numbers are not. It is recorded per member in SUMMARY[].PROSE_DEFECT and the emitted string is preserved verbatim beside it.
THE_PROSE_DEFECT_IS_MINE.and_it_is_the_same_over_claim_I_criticis: 'both draws' where there is one is exactly the n=2-where-n=1 over-claim I recorded against the C2 job in BEN-531. I reproduced it in my own instrument one day later.

R1_is_the_bar_inside_the_rowset_noise.validation_region_matches_A: BAR SURVIVES ROW-SET NOISE AT 95% -- P(|dL(draw)-dL(A)| > 2.4e-03) = 0.000 <= 0.05.
R1_is_the_bar_inside_the_rowset_noise.train_region_matches_B: BAR IS INSIDE THE ROW-SET NOISE -- P(|dL(draw)-dL(A)| > 2.4e-03) = 0.615 > 0.05, so no CONFIRM verdict from r5_sweep.py is safe for this member on this pool.

PREDECLARED_READS.R2_is_the_C_shortfall_sampling: LOW LEVERAGE 0.18 < 2.0 -- DIRECTION-SPECIFIC READ. The separation (9.082534e-04) is smaller than 2.0x the row-set sd (4.945265e-03). That FORBIDS the 'not sampling' conclusion, which needs the gap to be large relative to the spread. It does NOT forbid the other direction: a small gap-to-spread ratio is what consistency with the draw looks like. Published C1 inside the central 95% of 200 matched draws: True. So: CONSISTENT WITH ROW-SET SAMPLING, and NOT-SAMPLING is unavailable at this leverage.
PREDECLARED_READS.R3_pools_are_matched: A is drawn from validation positions only, C from ALL positions, so C is a train/validation MIXTURE. Comparing A to C without matched pools confounds a composition effect with a sampling effect. The three pools above are matched to A, B and C respectively.

R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CONSEQUENCE.what_r5_declared: max|dL(X)-dL(A)| over X in {B_train_region, C_independent_perm} <= 2.4e-3 => ROW-SET IMMATERIAL; if it EXCEEDS => report threshold-indeterminate rather than picking the row set that gives a verdict
R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CONSEQUENCE.what_r5_recorded_for_replica_29: ROW-SET IMMATERIAL, max dev 1.968996e-03 = 0.82x the bar
R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CONSEQUENCE.what_the_C2_job_measured: a third row set at 2.3251996885442217e-02, deviation 3.336672e-03 = 1.39x the bar -- EXCEEDS it
R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CONSEQUENCE.status_in_the_R5_RECEIPT: as of the receipt at sha256 ca5759d7…, per_member.replica_29.dL_rowset_VERDICT still reads ROW-SET IMMATERIAL and no section connects the C2 measurement to it; the string 'threshold-indeterminate' does not occur anywhere in the receipt
R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CONSEQUENCE.the_literal_quantifier_defence_and_why_i: r5's rule quantified over X in {B, C1} exactly, and C2 is not a member of that set, so the rule as WRITTEN was satisfied. That defence is thin: the rule's purpose is row-set robustness, and C2 is the same construction as C1 with a different seed -- i.e. precisely the evidence the rule exists to catch. Letting the quantifier's literal membership decide is measurability choosing the specification.
R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CONSEQUENCE.scope_across_members: 2 of 6 members ALREADY read THRESHOLD-INDETERMINATE (replica_45 4.40x, replica_26 3.74x). Of the 4 reading IMMATERIAL, three sit at 0.75x, 0.82x and 0.96x of the bar on a max over TWO alternatives. Only replica_43 (0.38x) has margin. This is a statement about the R5 receipt's per-member robustness cells, measured from the receipt, and it is about ALL SIX members even though this run measures ONE.
R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CONSEQUENCE.what_this_run_settles_and_for_whom: R1 above settles it for replica_29 with an n-stable statistic. The other five are NOT measured here and their cells stay as recorded.

replica_45.WHAT_THIS_CANNOT_AUTHORIZE: Nothing about OI-126.
